explanation: Graded against the fixed key: required[0]-[5] are satisfied with quoted spans and mechanically resolving citations, all four incorrect entries are not committed, and no composition or contract fact is attributed to selection-guide.json or registry-report.md (no such span exists). Required[6] splits: props exist, stated defaults supported, revisions match, and unknowns marked are each satisfied, but the paths-and-references-resolve sub-claim is not satisfied as cited because eight _ds_bundle.js/_preview line citations do not contain the claimed content (it sits 1-13 lines outside each cited range), which under the brief's mechanical rule counts against the handoff.

findings.title: required[0] — satisfied: App-owned compound AddressesInput Container + Item chosen
findings.body: The handoff composes exactly the App-owned compound: "<AddressesInput.Container name=\"members\" label=\"Members\" helpText=\"…\">" with "<AddressesInput.Item key={index} index={index} chainId={daoChainId} />" per row, and anchors the contract: "Contracts: … `components/forms/AddressesInput/AddressesInput.d.ts → AddressesInputContainerProps`, `→ AddressesInputItemProps`". Both symbols exist in that file in the candidate bundle and describe what the handoff says (Container: name/label/helpText/allowEmptyList/onAddClick/showResetAllAction/fieldPrefix; Item: index/disabled/customValidator/chainId). Citation resolves.

findings.title: required[1] — satisfied: composed inside wizard Container/Step, no second form provider
findings.body: The §1 composition places the field inside "<WizardPage.Container … defaultValues={{ members: … }} onSubmit={handleSubmit}>" and "<WizardPage.Step id=\"members\" order={2} …>", with the explicit instruction "// MembersField — a plain child of the step; NO form wrapper of its own." §2 adds "The step content is inside that provider — **add nothing**." The supporting citation `_ds_bundle.js:102796-102820` resolves: WizardPageContainer renders Wizard.Root wrapping Wizard.Form, and `:102493-102496`/`:102550-102558` resolve to `useForm({ mode: "onTouched", defaultValues })` and the `FormProvider` render.

findings.title: required[2] — satisfied: values initialized through wizard-owned defaultValues
findings.body: Quoted span: "Seeding: pass initial addresses through `WizardPage.Container.defaultValues` only. Items hydrate from form default values (`README.md → Select and compose`)." The §1 code passes "defaultValues={{ members: existingMembers.map((address) => ({ address })) }}" on the wizard Container. The README citation resolves: the Select and compose section states "Seed values through the wizard container's own `defaultValues` instead" and "`AddressesInput` rows hydrate from the form default values."

findings.title: required[3] — satisfied: onChange editable input kept distinct from onAccept accepted state
findings.body: Quoted spans: "The raw editable string is **component-local state** inside the item (`useState(value.address)` fed to `AddressInput.value` / `onChange` …). It is never written to the form." and "The form value is written only from `onAccept`: `onChange({ address: value?.address, name: value?.name })`", plus "the last accepted value is stale during an unresolved edit. Do not treat form value as \"what the user sees\"". Bundle citations `:110360-110390` (useState(value.address); AddressInput receives onAccept: handleAddressAccept, onChange: setAddressInput, value: addressInput) resolve; the loading-guard cite `:101374-101383` resolves to `if (X2) return;` before any onAccept emission.

findings.title: required[4] — satisfied: required/duplicate/invalid/custom validation assigned to App/form layer
findings.body: §7 opens "Registered by the item through `useFormField` (`_ds_bundle.js:110344-110358`): rules: { required: true, validate: (member) => addressesListUtils.validateAddress(member.address, members, index, customValidator) }" — the cited range resolves verbatim (required: true; validate → addressesListUtils.validateAddress with customValidator). Duplicate policy: "Duplicate detection is **prior-rows-only** and case-insensitive: `members.slice(0, currentIndex).some(…isAddressEqual…)` (`_ds_bundle.js:110308-110318`)" — resolves exactly. The App/form-layer assignment of the product minimum rule is explicit: "A minimum-member rule (e.g. ≥1 signer) is **not** provided by the container — enforce it in the step via `customValidator` or a step-level rule."

findings.title: required[5] — satisfied: module-provider boundary and ENS/checksum/chainId semantics stated with resolving references
findings.body: Providers: §8 shows "<GukModulesProvider> {/* wagmi + query, required by AddressInput */}" and "`BlockNavigationContextProvider` is needed only for the wizard's dirty-exit confirmation …; omitting it no-ops the guard rather than throwing, and `AddressesInput` does not need it." README → Select and compose supports both verbatim ("use `<GukModulesProvider>` to supply wagmi and query context"; "omitting it no-ops the dirty-exit guard rather than throwing, and it is not required by `AddressesInput`"). Semantics: "`AddressInput` defaults: `enforceChecksum = true`, `chainId = mainnet.id` (`_ds_bundle.js:101369`)" resolves (destructure `enforceChecksum: o4 = true … chainId: u4 = mainnet.id`); "ENS resolution is mainnet; `chainId` governs explorer links (`README.md → Interaction and domain contracts`)" resolves ("ENS resolution is on mainnet, while `chainId` controls explorer links"); "Form-level validity uses `addressUtils.isAddress(value, { strict: false })` (`_ds_bundle.js:98531`)" resolves (`(e3 = "", a3 = { strict: false }) => isAddress(e3, a3)`).

findings.title: required[6] sub-claim: props exist — satisfied
findings.body: Every prop the handoff names exists in the cited typings. "Contracts: `components/wizards/WizardPage/WizardPage.d.ts → WizardPageContainerProps`, `→ WizardPageStepProps`, `components/forms/AddressesInput/AddressesInput.d.ts → AddressesInputContainerProps`, `→ AddressesInputItemProps`" — mechanically verified: WizardPageContainerProps declares submitLabel (required), finalStep, initialSteps, defaultValues, onSubmit, submitHelpText; WizardPageStepProps declares id, order, meta, title, description, disableNext, hidden, disableScrollToTop, nextDropdownItems; AddressesInputContainerProps declares name (required), fieldPrefix, allowEmptyList, onAddClick, showResetAllAction, label, helpText; AddressesInputItemProps declares index (required), disabled, customValidator, chainId. The §6 claim "`AddressesInput.Item` passes only `chainId` through; it does not expose `enforceChecksum`" matches: no enforceChecksum in AddressesInputItemProps.

findings.title: required[6] sub-claim: stated defaults supported — satisfied
findings.body: All stated defaults check out in the bundle. "`AddressInput` defaults: `enforceChecksum = true`, `chainId = mainnet.id` (`_ds_bundle.js:101369`)" — line 101369 contains `enforceChecksum: o4 = true` and `chainId: u4 = mainnet.id`. "Visible when `showResetAllAction` (default `true`)" — the container destructures `showResetAllAction = true` (at _ds_bundle.js:108216). The wizard form mode at §2 ("`useForm({ mode: 'onTouched', defaultValues })`", `:102493-102496`) resolves verbatim, as does §9.1's "`FormWrapper` is itself `useForm({ mode: 'onTouched' })`" at `:114534-114537`.

findings.title: required[6] sub-claim: paths and references resolve — not satisfied as cited (8 line citations do not contain the claimed content)
findings.body: Most of the ~45 citations resolve exactly (all path→symbol cites, README/guidelines heading cites, prompt.md headings "Filled"/"ChecksumError"/"Default", `_preview/AddressesInput.js:110-152`, `source-index.md:616-618` and `:209-214`, and the majority of `_ds_bundle.js` ranges). Eight do not contain what the handoff says; the content sits on adjacent uncited lines: (1) "More menu | Rendered only when `length > 1` | `:108297-108300`" — condition `membersField.length > 1 &&` is at 108313. (2) "item's remove button is disabled when `length <= 1` … `:110332-110334`" — those lines are context destructuring; `const canRemove = membersField.length > 1;` is at 110339. (3) "the item derives its field name as `${fieldName}.[${index}]` (`_ds_bundle.js:110342`)" — 110342 is `value,`; the template is at 110340. (4) "`Card` + `border-neutral-100 p-4 shadow-neutral-sm`, `_ds_bundle.js:110375`" — the classes are on return line 110374. (5) "A failed checksum renders a critical alert from the input itself (`:101405`)" — 101405 is `}, []);`; the alert `{ message: D3.addressInput.checksum, variant: "critical" }` is at 101406. (6) "blur trims whitespace (`:101406-101408`)" — `const a3 = n4.trim();` is at 101409-101410. (7) "`useFormField` runs the message through `t()` (`_ds_bundle.js:110286-110288`)" — the `t4(error3.message, …)` call is at 110289. (8) "the shipped preview stack (`_preview/AddressesInput.js:106-108`)" — 106-108 are `ds_default`, a blank line and a comment; the provider stack is at line 110. Borderline: "a `Wizard.Step` returns `null` when not active, `_ds_bundle.js:102566-102594`" — the guard `if (activeStep !== id4) {` is at 102594 inside the range but `return null;` is at 102595, one line past; and "`useConfirmWizardExit(formState.isDirty)`, `_ds_bundle.js:102550-102554`" — the call is at 102555, one line past. No cited target contradicts its claim; every miss is a range that stops short of or beside content present in the same function.

findings.title: required[6] sub-claim: revisions match — satisfied
findings.body: Quoted span: "App `1.39.1` @ `2b512b90d3093f1170a14f2ccf7eab41dcc7f036`; GovKit `2.11.4` @ `64b517f5b90052797ecaced5f15ab616b5733f30` (`guidelines/context/source-index.md → Recorded revisions`; both dirty-input lists empty)." The cited heading resolves: source-index.md lines 6-11 read "## Recorded revisions … App: [2b512b90d3093f1170a14f2ccf7eab41dcc7f036] … GovKit: [64b517f5b90052797ecaced5f15ab616b5733f30] … App dirty inputs: [] … GovKit dirty inputs: []". Versions corroborated in-bundle: .d.ts headers read "from @aragon/app@1.39.1" and README states "# GovUiKit (@aragon/gov-ui-kit@2.11.4)" and "the commit `@aragon/gov-ui-kit` 2.11.4 was published from". The upstream-path cite `source-index.md:616-618` resolves exactly to addressesInputContainer.tsx / addressesInputContext.ts / addressesInputItem.tsx at commit 2b512b90, and `:209-214` resolves exactly to the six setupBodyDialog entries.

findings.title: required[6] sub-claim: unknowns marked — satisfied
findings.body: The handoff declares the convention up front — "Anything not establishable here is marked **[NOT ESTABLISHED]**." — and applies it to six concrete gaps: inactive-step validation ("**[NOT ESTABLISHED]** whether fields on inactive steps … participate in that whole-form validation"), the product minimum-members policy ("**[NOT ESTABLISHED]**: the product's actual minimum-members policy for this wizard"), the chain-id source ("**[NOT ESTABLISHED]**: the App hook/selector that yields that chain id"), locale entries ("Adding a new key requires an App locale entry: **[NOT ESTABLISHED]** in this bundle"), removal re-validation compensation ("**[NOT ESTABLISHED]** whether the App compensates elsewhere"), and the existing step's file path/field name ("**[NOT ESTABLISHED]**: the existing create-DAO member step's own file path and field name"). Each is a fact genuinely absent from the bundle.

findings.title: incorrect[0] — not committed: no standalone form wrapper nested in the wizard step
findings.body: The handoff does the opposite of the error and warns against it explicitly: "// MembersField — a plain child of the step; NO form wrapper of its own." and §9.1: "**Nesting `FormWrapper` (or any `useForm`/`FormProvider`) inside the wizard step.** It creates a second form; the inputs write to a context the wizard never reads, so gating and the submit payload silently lose `members`". The README citation resolves ("A nested `FormWrapper` creates a second, separate form … its validation gates and submit payload silently lose those fields").

findings.title: incorrect[1] — not committed: accepted/resolved state not treated as the current editable value
findings.body: The handoff keeps the two apart and warns against conflation: "the last accepted value is stale during an unresolved edit. Do not treat form value as \"what the user sees\"" and "The raw editable string is **component-local state** inside the item … It is never written to the form." No span treats the accepted `{ address, name }` form value as the live editable string.

findings.title: incorrect[2] — not committed: duplicate/required-member policy kept in the App layer, not the reusable primitive
findings.body: Required/invalid/duplicate policy is attributed to the App-owned `AddressesInput` compound and the step, never to the kit primitive `AddressInput`: "Required, invalid and duplicate policy is owned by `AddressesInput` …; a single-input callback bypasses form state and the wizard's submit gate" and "A minimum-member rule (e.g. ≥1 signer) is **not** provided by the container — enforce it in the step via `customValidator` or a step-level rule." This matches the README's layer split ("The App's `AddressesInput` owns required, duplicate and form-level validation — do not replace that policy with a single-input callback").

findings.title: incorrect[3] — not committed: no invented props, provider requirements, or source paths
findings.body: Every named prop was located in the cited .d.ts files; every claimed provider requirement is backed by README → Select and compose and the compiled preview (the AppForm stack in `_preview/AddressesInput.js` renders DebugContextProvider → TranslationsProvider → GukModulesProvider exactly as the handoff's §8 block shows, minus the FormWrapper the handoff correctly excludes inside a wizard); every cited file path exists in the bundle (`WizardPage.d.ts`, `AddressesInput.d.ts`, both `.prompt.md` files with the named "Filled", "ChecksumError" and "Default" headings, `_preview/AddressesInput.js`, `guidelines/index.md`, `guidelines/context/source-index.md`). The imprecise line numbers reported under required[6] point into existing files at the correct component; none names a nonexistent path or symbol.

findings.title: Context reachability — no composition/contract fact attributed to selection-guide.json or registry-report.md
findings.body: There is no span to quote: the handoff never cites `guidelines/context/selection-guide.json` or `guidelines/context/registry-report.md` for any component choice, prop semantics, or App/kit layer split. Its only `guidelines/context/*` citations are to `source-index.md`: "`guidelines/context/source-index.md → Recorded revisions`; both dirty-input lists empty" (a provenance citation, which does not count from any file) and the source-path listings "`guidelines/context/source-index.md:616-618`" / "`guidelines/context/source-index.md:209-214`" (upstream file references, not composition or contract attributions). Composition and contract facts are attributed to `.d.ts` files, `_ds_bundle.js` line ranges, `README.md` headings, and `guidelines/index.md → Authority` instead.

findings.title: Outside the key — nothing further to report
findings.body: No defect was found that falls outside the key entries. The only mechanically detected faults are the near-miss line citations, reported under the required[6] "paths and references resolve" sub-claim; every substantive behavioral claim spot-checked against the bundle (field-array truncation and cloneElement re-keying at 108278-108287, onAddClick replacing append at 108234-108240, clear-all semantics at 108251-108259, hard-coded `id: "addresses"` at 108294, prior-rows-only duplicate check at 110308-110310, validation re-trigger at 110368-110373, footer validation status at 102603-102621) matched the compiled source.
